summary_markdown: The conversation focused on the availability of lidar data from multiple sources. It was noted that only two lidars are sending data, and one specific unit (p01) is only available at a particular location ([redacted]). This unit has five left-side and one right-side active sensors. A discussion arose regarding whether the displayed images were meant to show general orientation (left vs. right) or if they represented the latest lidar feed. It was confirmed that data from a specific, recently activated lidar unit was unavailable.
decisions: Confirmed that only two lidar units are currently sending data.
